text: What is crypto? Monkeys use leaves to buy things. Leaves used by most monkeys as currency. But there are some downsides to leaves. Leaves controlled by monkey banks. Every time monkeys buy something with leaves, monkey banks take a bit extra. Buying things with leaves often takes long time for monkey banks to process, especially if monkeys send leaves to other monkey countries. Monkey banks can print more leaves, which can cause inflation. Not every monkey has access to monkey bank. Leaves can be faked. Monkey bank isn't always open. So monkeys invent new currency. Monkeys use bananas. How does crypto work? Bananas are not controlled by one monkey or monkey bank. Bananas are controlled by entire troop. Every time monkey buys something with banana, there are usually no fees. Or maybe just a very small fee. Unless it's particularly busy. Buying things with bananas is very quick. Even internationally. Every monkey can do it without having to go to monkey banks. Some bananas have limited supply, which means no inflation. Bananas can't be faked. Monkeys can also trade bananas 24-7. Blocks. But monkeys need a way to keep track of all banana transactions. Banks use receipts to keep track of all leaf transactions. But they control it and keep most of the information to themselves. So monkeys write down their banana transactions. Then they are added to the big rock. Or block for short. Where all monkeys can see them all the time. Every monkey even gets a copy of the block instead of it all being controlled by one monkey bank. Crypto mining. These are the monkeys that etch each banana transaction into the block. The banana miners check each banana transaction to make sure everything is right. They throw out any obviously fake trades. Then etch each correct banana transaction into the block. Finally when the block is full, the banana miners must guess the correct code for the block. This is like a password they don't remember. They just keep trying until one of them gets it right. This is called proof of work. Once a monkey guesses right, they are rewarded with bananas. All other monkeys can quickly check the number and confirm it works. This method of tracking bananas is safe. No one monkey controls the block and every monkey can see the block because block is big. If a monkey tries to sneak a block full of fake transactions, all monkeys can see it and reject the block. What is the blockchain? When the banana miners have finished a block, they share it with every monkey in troop. Every monkey gets a copy of the new block. Every time this happens, monkeys simply add another block to the chain. This called the blockchain. Each block has its own code and the code of the previous block. This is what makes them a chain. Monkeys can't go back and change a block without re-guessing all the codes for the following blocks. Which is nearly impossible. How was crypto invented? The creator of bananas is a bit of a mystery. No monkey knows for sure. There are monkeys that claim they invented bananas, but this is very unlikely. All monkeys know for sure is the name Satoshi Nakamoto. Wait a minute. If I remove the A, T, S, H, and two O's, rearrange the remaining letters. Investing in crypto. Most monkeys buy crypto like a stock. Buying when the price is low and selling when it's high. At least that's the plan. Some monkeys see crypto value go up. Crypto more rare, crypto more valuable. So monkeys get excited and invest in crypto without even thinking about risks. This is called aping. Yes, really. Unlike most stocks, crypto very volatile. If stock market is smooth car ride through countryside, crypto is rocket powered roller coaster. Crypto is still a very new currency. Things like news, rumors, even one monkey tweet can hugely affect crypto price. Some monkeys choose to buy crypto and not sell for very long time. No matter what happens. This is called hodling. Disadvantages. Some cryptocurrencies have unlimited supply, which can lead to losing value. Crypto become common. Crypto miners need a lot of equipment to mine crypto. This often has negative environmental effects as more and more crypto is mined. Crypto also has a shady reputation as some monkeys use it to buy illegal items. There is a common crypto scam where some monkeys, not saying who, promote their new cryptocurrency to a lot of unsuspecting monkeys. Monkeys get excited, like really excited. Monkeys invest in crypto, crypto price goes up, then monkey sells most of the crypto. Crypto price goes down, leaving all other monkeys with no money and crypto that is close to worthless. This is called a rug pull. While most monkeys agree the blockchain is safe, monkeys can still steal bananas from other individual monkeys. And while the number of monkeys trading with bananas is increasing, most monkeys still prefer to use leaves. The future of crypto. There are many different cryptocurrencies popping up every day. Some with plenty of research behind them, and some that are more of a joke. Some monkeys say crypto is the future. Other monkeys say it will never be. But most monkeys say
